title: Inheritance versus composition
answer: Inheritance models an is-a relationship where a subtype extends a parent contract and may reuse or override behavior. Composition models a has-a relationship where one object owns or collaborates with another object without becoming its subtype. AeroTopo uses inheritance because `Orthomosaic` and `Dem` are Products; `Product` uses composition because it owns a list of tile IDs. Composition is often preferred when reuse does not require substitutability.
